sv.title: Wilma slutade ta insulin – när hon mobbades för sin diabetes
sv.summary: Wilma Berngarn, 20, fick diagnosen diabetes typ 1 redan som sexåring. Då fanns inga pumpar eller sensorer utan hon var tvungen att ta sprutor med insulin. De andra barnen ville först inte sitta bredvid henne i klassrummet.

en.title: Wilma stopped taking insulin – when she was bullied for her diabetes
en.summary: Wilma Berngarn, 20, was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes as early as age six. Back then there were no pumps or sensors; she had to take insulin injections. At first the other children did not want to sit next to her in the classroom.
